claims.claim: Original Ambro Brother embroidery Sewing machine.
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a blue 'AIG BROTHER' sewing machine; no clear embroidery-specific features or exact model/brand confirmation.
No photo evidence of durability; only external appearance is described.
No stitch-quality test or sample fabric work shown.
No marking/label in the witness report confirming country of manufacture.
Witness report does not include a power-on/running test.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not list or show included accessories/manual.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No service/maintenance records or evidence of internal condition shown.

risks.risk: Motor/power system may not run smoothly or may fail under load (common hidden issue for used machines).
risks.proof: A short video clip of powering on and running the machine while sewing a straight line on fabric (showing consistent motion and no unusual noise/smell).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working/unknown motor condition.

risks.risk: Stitch quality/tension/bobbin winding may be poor even if it powers on.
risks.proof: A close-up photo/video of completed stitches (straight seam and a few inches of consistent tension) plus bobbin area showing correct winding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing adjustment/possible tuning for stitch quality.

risks.risk: Wrong or worn needle/presser foot/feed mechanism could cause poor feeding or damage fabric.
risks.proof: Photos of the needle size/type marking, presser foot type, and feed dogs (clear close-ups).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing/worn consumables and possible replacement needed.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/manual or incomplete pedal/power cable set.
risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo showing every included accessory and the original manual; include the pedal and power cable clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete kit (no manual/accessories confirmed).

risks.risk: Hidden rust, cracks, belt/drive wear, or misalignment may exist despite a decent exterior.
risks.proof: Photos of underside/drive area (belt/drive components) and any visible joints/hinges; plus a brief running clip to detect vibration.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible wear/unknown internal condition.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch or embroidery capability not actually present (witness only confirms 'AIG BROTHER' externally).
risks.proof: Photo of the machine’s identification plate/model label and any embroidery-specific attachments/hoop area (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used sewing machine with embroidery claims unconfirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the identification plate/model label (brand, model, and country of manufacture).
Send a video: power on + sewing a straight seam on fabric for at least a few inches, showing consistent feed and tension.
Send close-ups of needle, presser foot, and feed dogs.
Send photos of the bobbin area and bobbin winding performance (or a short clip showing bobbin operation).
Send a laid-out inventory photo of all accessories included, plus the original manual (show cover/title).
Send photos of the underside/drive area (belt/drive components) and any visible wear/rust.
response.reason: The witness confirms the machine’s external appearance and some visible parts, but key value drivers (working condition, stitch quality, included accessories/manual, and exact model/embroidery capability) are not proven by the report. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
